sources.title: Action Chunking with Transformers - ACT — Open Edge Platform Documentation
sources.snippet: Action Chunking with Transformers (ACT) is an end-to-end imitation learning model designed for fine manipulation tasks in robotics, learned directly from real demonstrations. ACT aims to overcome the limitations of imitation learning, where policy errors can compound over time and lead to drifting out of the training distribution.
